reply:
The issue is SQLite doesn't support the YEAR() function. I need to use strftime() to extract years from dates.

QUERY: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday FROM Patient p WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1937' AND p.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.ID FROM Laboratory l WHERE l."T-CHO" >= 250)
